scope: Train a temporal adapter on an already pretrained MNIST image DDPM, then gate video quality before any video GRPO. This is a locally trained toy-video model, not the released Moving-MNIST checkpoint.
data: MNIST train digits, deterministic affine translations of one digit per 4-frame clip; independent MNIST test digits for visual/metric context
feasibility_gate: At least 6/8 clips have finite frames, mean pixel intensity in [0.03,0.35], independent digit confidence >=0.7 averaged over frames, frame-class consistency >=0.75, and nonstatic centroid displacement >=0.5 pixels; inspect grids visually

grpo_if_gate_passes.primary_reward: proxy digit confidence and same-class fraction, multiplied by a bounded motion/ink guard

stop_rule: Do not start GRPO if baseline gate fails; stop runs for nonfinite values or sustained ratio clipping; no paid compute
